newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: TENNIS-PO BEATS DAVENPORT IN OPEN CLASH.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-PO BEATS DAVENPORT IN OPEN CLASH.

text.p: Unseeded Kimberly Po of the United States beat her seventh-seeded compatriot Lindsay Davenport on Sunday to reach the quarter-finals of the Australian Open.
On a day of surprises at the tournament, the 23rd ranked Po ousted Davenport 7-6, 6-4 in 95 minutes.
It was an evenly-balanced and at times scrappy match which could have gone either way. Po won the first set in a 15-13 tie-break before a hard-fought second set.

But Po, who will meet either world number one Steffi Graf or South African 12th seed Amanda Coetzer in the quarter-finals, was the most consistent and committed of the two players, producing more forehand winners.
Earlier on Sunday, German fifth seed Anke Huber became the first seed to drop out of the fourth round, losing to 1995 champion Mary Pierce in straight sets.
